title: grow3-knowledge canonical OS frontmatter v0.1
description: Validates YAML frontmatter of canonical OS Markdown files after safe parsing into a JSON-compatible object. Covers file identity and metadata staleness tracking only—not Markdown body content. Frontmatter extraction, YAML syntax, and duplicate key detection are outside this schema (see DEC-012 extraction contract, reused verbatim). Semantic drift of the body is intentionally out of scope.

fileId.description: Stable identifier of the file. Must equal the filename without the .md extension.

osType.description: os = a design/operating manual that is applied directly. map = a correspondence table that routes to other files. Intentionally kept to two values; do not create many tags up front.

osStatus.description: canonical status is granted by human approval only. A Claude-generated candidate stays draft until approved (see DEC-019).

domainList.description: Subject domains this file is authoritative for. The enum is deliberately small; extending it is a structural change requiring approval.

relatedList.description: Optional. IDs of canonical files this file depends on or complements. Changes to this list count as a structural change.

metadataSourceHash.description: SHA-256 of the Markdown body that this frontmatter describes. Algorithm is fixed here (unlike organization-diagnosis register_snapshot_hash, which DEC-012 deliberately left unspecified): take the text after the closing frontmatter delimiter, normalize newlines to LF, strip trailing whitespace, append one LF, encode UTF-8, hash, and prefix with 'sha256:'. A mismatch against the actual body means STALE.
